verdict.rationale: Bolt documents built-in AI agents (Standard and Max) that take control of the filesystem, terminal, package manager and deployment from chat. A Plan Mode, a security check-and-fix task, and automatic model routing add to this. Hands-on users report building apps with "99% of edits made through prompts," while other reports of breakage loops and unwanted changes lower confidence in reliability, not in whether delegation exists. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on agent task scope and limits (the agents page is only a thin mention), and evidence of consistently reliable task completion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Bolt offers two agents, Standard and Max, powered by large language models.
Bolt.new gives AI models complete control over the entire environment including the filesystem, node server, package manager, terminal, and browser console.
Bolt can check your project for security problems and fix what it finds.
both were built in bolt with 99% of edits made through prompts
